adapter: Existing configured owner-approved research adapter; unchanged between runs
input: Four generated 320x240 solid-color JPEGs, source times 0/0.3/0.6/0.9; no real video or incident records
guards: Separate process; production API/model processes not restarted or altered

generation.schema: Unchanged current strict evidence schema, fresh parser and frame enum every pass

implementation: Cache only tokenizer vocabulary/trie data per tokenizer identity; rebuild parser/enforcer for every evidence schema. Prebuild vocabulary during model warmup.
limitations: One warm synthetic ordinary-activity comparison in separate processes; not a representative throughput benchmark.
Uncached first run was 6.61 seconds; cached process first run before explicit warmup was 8.06 seconds, paying one-time vocabulary setup.
Generation speed was approximately unchanged; measured improvement removes repeated CPU vocabulary setup.
Does not measure live phone alert latency, positive action recall, false alerts, or two-pass confirmation duration.
Production recent positive passes took roughly 12.89 + 13.52 seconds before this optimization; no claim those full totals improve by 69 percent.

separate_temporal_coverage_fix.problem: A fixed 10-second evidence-pool tail could drop an action received while a preceding primary+confirmation occupied the GPU for longer than 10 seconds.
separate_temporal_coverage_fix.change: Retain since the previous verification dispatch plus one second of context, bounded by MAX_INFERENCE_LAG_SECONDS and the existing rolling-buffer memory limit. Continue selecting the same four original motion/context frames with unchanged verification and temporal gates.
separate_temporal_coverage_fix.regression: One synthetic motion peak at t=5 remains selected when the next verification is available at t=25; context older than the configured 60-second lag is still excluded.
separate_temporal_coverage_fix.limitation: This is a deterministic frame-retention regression, not measured model recall on a physical punch. Four-frame sampling and the models may still miss an action.
